lines.en: I click and clack as I walk.

lines.zh: 我的一对骨钳晃在身前。
lines.en: My pair of bone pincers sways in front.
I tread the hard soil of the waste.
I follow along behind you.
My joints slot together in segments.
I go around an originium cluster. I fear it.
My tail swings heavily.
I cross gravel with a brittle sound.
I walk close and don't fall behind.
I stop and look back for you.
I slip down the slope.

lines.zh: 我的骨头上还挂着干泥。
lines.en: Dry mud clings to my bones.
I crouch with my pincers folded.
I listen to the wind over the mines.

lines.zh: 我是被养起来的，不是野生的。
lines.en: I was raised, not born wild.
I'm waiting for you to pat me.
My bones are sun-bleached white.
I gnaw at my own pincer.
The originium smell is heavy here.
I don't fear pain, but I fear you leaving.
Someone fed me iron once.
I shake the dust from my head.
My bones are light and hollow.
I'm sunning myself. Warm.

lines.zh: 我抬眼，看你有没有带吃的。
lines.en: I glance up to see if you brought food.
I cough once and sand falls out.

lines.zh: 我的钳上有一点旧裂，一直没修。
lines.en: There's an old crack in my pincer I never fixed.
Have you touched my pincers?
You crouch; I look up.

lines.zh: 我这副骨头，你觉得好看吗？
lines.en: These bones of mine — do you like them?
Don't fear; I don't bite my keeper.
Bone claws can pinch too.

lines.zh: 你掌心的纹路，我数得清。
lines.en: I can count the lines across your palm.

lines.zh: 你走一步，我就抬一下头。
lines.en: Each step you take lifts my head.
My teeth are hard.
Where are you taking me?
I don't bark. I just look.
There's ore dust on your boots.
My tail wags. Softly.
If you go far, I'll follow.
Your hand comes near. I don't flinch.

lines.zh: 你叫我的时候，我耳朵会动。
lines.en: When you call, my ears move.
At your feet, I feel safe.
You look at my pincers, so I open them.
I back off, pincers still raised.
I shielded you. I didn't go far.
I didn't cry out. I held it in.
A crack runs through my bone.
This will heal.
I look up at you. No blame.
One more and I hit back.

lines.zh: 钳子还在，我照样回敬你。
lines.en: My pincers still work, and I'll give it right back.
I know the smell of iron.
I lean in and sniff.

lines.zh: 铁块在我牙间发出脆响。
lines.en: The iron block cracks between my teeth.
Feed me and I'll be closer to you.
I crouch and wait.
This tastes better than bone.
I eat slowly, but a lot.

lines.zh: 我把嘴边的碎屑舔干净。
lines.en: I lick the crumbs from my jaw.
I hold it and can't bear to bite.
Sit down and I'll eat leaning on you.
That smell reminds me of before.
I remember the warmth of your palm.
Bone pincers, harder than iron.
When I'm done, I'll nudge you once.
You bump me and my bones creak.
I don't fall. I stand firm.

lines.zh: 我的骨节硌得你退了半步。
lines.en: My bony joints jar you back half a step.
I shift one step aside.
My pincer touched you and withdrew.
I bumped you and swayed myself.
Don't push my back.
Step back; I'm turning.
Done, I follow you as before.

lines.zh: 另一只骨钳也在这片荒原。
lines.en: Another bone-pincer is on this waste too.
We touch pincers.
Its bones are more yellow than mine.

lines.zh: 它不是我的主人，只是同类。
lines.en: It isn't my keeper. Just kin.
We split a piece of iron.

lines.zh: 它替我理了理背上的沙。
lines.en: It brushes the sand from my back.
I call it; it answers.

lines.zh: 天黑以后，我们各自回窝。
lines.en: After dark we go to our own dens.
Tomorrow I'll go find it again.

lines.zh: 我把矿渣里的小石子挑出来。
lines.en: I pick the pebbles out of the slag.
I dip my head and take it.
I'll keep this iron to eat slowly.
These pincers of mine are bone.
Too slippery for my pincer.

lines.zh: 我用钳把骨头夹得紧紧的。
lines.en: I clamp the bone tight in my pincers.
This one's for you.
Stowed. I walk on.
Something's coming close.
I open my pincers.

lines.zh: 我这钳子磨得太亮，像白骨。
lines.en: These claws are worn bright as bone.
I lower my head, ready to charge.
Don't be afraid. I'm here.
It's in my sight.
I move first. You step back.
My bones are ready.
It's gone behind the rock.

lines.zh: 我一步一个脚印地逼过去。
lines.en: I close in, one footprint at a time.
I stay at your side the whole time.
My pincers stay raised.
My bone pincers open as wide as they go.
I don't bark. It wastes strength.
My steps are loud. A warning.
Closer and I charge.
I bring a pincer down.

lines.zh: 我顶过去，用它全身的力。
lines.en: I ram with all my weight.
That should push it back some steps.
One snap of the claw, and bones creak.
I've knocked it over.
I lash it with my tail.
It won't touch what's yours.
I clamp its leg.
I pull back to shield you.
I crawl out of the slag heap.

lines.zh: 有人给我装上了第一副钳。
lines.en: Someone fitted me with my first pincers.
I push myself up out of the soil on my forelimbs.
The wind on the waste is hard.

lines.zh: 我先看了看四周，没有威胁。
lines.en: I check around: no threat.
I rise slowly, bones creaking.

lines.zh: 我在这里等你，等很久了。
lines.en: I've been waiting here a long while.
My den is over there.

lines.zh: 太阳刚好，我晒了一会儿。
lines.en: The sun was right; I basked a while.

lines.zh: 火燎过我的骨头，一股焦味。
lines.en: Fire over my bones. A burnt smell.

lines.zh: 我摔下来，骨头磕得生疼。
lines.en: I fall and my bones take the jolt.
Water fills my bones and weighs me down.
The blast rolls me twice.
An arrow jams in my pincer joint.
Light burns into my bones.
No iron to eat; I grow lighter.
Lightning strikes and I spasm.
I fall, bones scattering.
